Kit summary

Frostedge SeizureActive
Deals [Direct DMG] equal to 10% of Skadi's Max HP to a single enemy, reduces its Turn Meter by 20% and has 100% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] (+40% Direct DMG taken) for 2 turns.
Frostmark HuntActive
Deals [Direct DMG] equal to 10% of Skadi's Max HP to a single enemy and gives the ally with the highest initial ATK 20% Turn Meter. When another ally casts a skill on their own turn and Skadi is not in [Resonance Enhancement], she casts Frostmark Hunt to pursue and attack once (once before her action). Resonance version: hits all enemies for 10% Max HP Direct DMG, gives all allies 20% Turn Meter and [Frostforged Bastion] equal to 50% of her Max HP for 2 turns, and is the pursue-and-attack while in Resonance Enhancement.
Frostcrystal Edge Lv.1When another ally pursues and attacks a non-Boss unit outside their turn, she casts Frostmark Hunt once to pursue and attack (once before her action); while in [Resonance Enhancement] she additionally casts Frostmark Hunt - Resonance once (once before her action).
Will of Eternal WinterPassive
Resonance Points max 10. When an ally deals DMG outside their own turn, Skadi gains 1 [Resonance Point] (once per ally before she acts); none while in [Resonance Enhancement]. At max, consumes 10 points, gains 50% Turn Meter and enters [Resonance Enhancement] for 4 turns: CD of Frostmark Hunt and Extreme Frost Seal -1 turn, both are replaced by their Resonance versions, and allies' pursue-and-attacks deal +20% Basic Attack and Skill DMG.
Frostcrystal Edge Lv.2If an ally has higher initial SPD than Skadi at battle start, she gains 100% Turn Meter and enters [Resonance Enhancement] for 4 turns. Gains 1 extra [Resonance Point] when an ally deals DMG to a non-Boss outside their turn, and 1 when another ally pursues and attacks (up to 3 times before she acts). While in Resonance Enhancement she is immune to Control and can gain Resonance Points, and allies dealing Direct DMG via pursue-and-attack gain 10% Turn Meter (up to 2 times before she acts).
Extreme Frost SealActive
Deals [Direct DMG] equal to 15% of Skadi's Max HP to all enemies, then grants all allies [Frostforged Bastion] equal to 50% of her Max HP (cannot be stolen or removed, max 2 layers) for 2 turns. Resonance version: also reduces enemy Turn Meter by 40% and grants allies [Frostforged Bastion] equal to 80% of her Max HP plus [Frostcrystal War Armor] (-50% Direct DMG and DoT taken) for 2 turns.
Frostcrystal Edge Lv.3Casting either version grants all allies [SPD Up II] (+40%) and [ATK Up II] (+40%) for 2 turns. The Resonance version inflicts [Extreme Frost Erosion] (-50% Skill DMG dealt, -50% Shield Effect received, loses 50% Shield value each turn) on all enemies for 2 turns. With 5 [Pursue & Attack] allies: first cast grants all allies 40% Turn Meter (once per battle), and for every 1% Max HP lost, a unit with [Frostcrystal War Armor] gains +1% DMG dealt and +1% DMG Reduction (each capped at 75%).
Frostcrystal Edge (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
